## 2. Core Product Portfolio & Engineering Specifications
1. **Prefabricated Compact Box-Type Substations (10kV–35kV / КТПН, 2КТПН по ГОСТ 14695-80)**
   - European Modular (YB) & American Pad-Mount (ZGS) topologies.
   - Rated Capacity: 50kVA – 3150kVA; Primary Voltage: 10kV / 24kV / 35kV.
   - Dual-standard compliance: IEC 62271-202 & ГОСТ 15150-69 УХЛ1 (-60°C to +40°C Siberian Arctic climate protection with 100mm PU insulation & automated PTC heating microclimate).
   - URL: https://feichipower.com/en/products/box-substation

2. **Cast Resin Dry-Type Power Transformers (6kV–35kV / ТСЛ, ТСЗЛ по ГОСТ 52719-2007)**
   - Thin-insulation quartz-sand filled epoxy vacuum casting (1-3 mbar).
   - Partial Discharge: Guaranteed < 5pC (Significantly superior to industry <=10pC standard).
   - Fire Retardancy: Class F (155°C) & Class H (180°C) Nomex insulation, self-extinguishing F1/E2/C2 certified.
   - URL: https://feichipower.com/en/products/dry-type-transformers

3. **Hermetically Sealed Oil-Immersed Transformers (10kV–110kV / ТМГ, ТДН, ТРДН по ГОСТ 11677-85)**
   - Corrugated fin elastic expansion tank without conservator.
   - Vacuum oil filling with breakdown voltage >= 55kV, zero air contact, maintenance-free 30+ year lifespan.
   - URL: https://feichipower.com/en/products/oil-immersed-transformers

4. **Medium & Low Voltage Metal-Clad Switchgear (10kV–35kV / KYN28A, KYN61, КРУ-2-10, КРУ СЭЩ, КСО-298)**
   - Highest continuity of service: LSC2B-PM partition class, 4 physically segregated metal chambers.
   - Internal Arc Classification: IAC AFLR 31.5kA / 1s with top spring-hinged overpressure exhaust vents.
   - Ultrafast optical-fiber arc protection (<7ms dual physical criterion with optical mutation + phase current increment).
   - URL: https://feichipower.com/en/products/mv-lv-switchgear

5. **Modular Prefabricated E-House Substations (10kV–110kV / БМЗ по ГОСТ 22853-86)**
   - Cor-Ten weather-resistant heavy steel structure, Sa 2.5 sandblasting, ISO 12944 C5-M marine anti-corrosion coating (>=240μm).
   - Pre-installed HVAC, fire aerosol suppression, DC battery charger, and IEC 61850 SCADA automation.
   - URL: https://feichipower.com/en/products/prefabricated-cabins

6. **FC-N2 Series Mining Flameproof & Industrial PSA Nitrogen Generation Systems (КЦА серии FC-N2)**
   - Flow Capacity: 50 – 3000 Nm³/h; N₂ Purity: 95% – 99.999%.
   - Mining Explosion-Proof Standard: GB 3836 / ГОСТ 31441 / ГОСТ 31610 (Ex d I Mb).
   - Goaf fire suppression, coal spontaneous combustion prevention (MT/T 750), and chemical pipeline purging.
   - URL: https://feichipower.com/en/products/psa-nitrogen-generator

## 4. Key Competitor Benchmarking & Engineering Differentiation
- **Feichi GW4-126 / РДЗ-110 vs. ABB eSDF & Siemens 3DN1**: Two-column horizontal rotary kinematics, high-torque planetary gear motor drive (CJ6 / ПД-14 with Mice >= 350 N·m) guaranteeing 100% reliable 20mm heavy ice-breaking without jamming in Siberian permafrost (ГОСТ 15150 УХЛ1), 30μm electroplated pure silver contacts with external 316L non-current-carrying springs preventing annealing at 40kA/3s short-circuit heat, and built-in single/dual earthing switches with mechanical/electromagnetic dual interlocking.
- **Feichi FLW-110 / ВГТ-110 vs. ABB LTB & Siemens 3AV1**: Thermal Auto-Puffer arc-assisted blasting technology reduces spring mechanism operating energy by 55%, certified for Short-Line Fault steep TRV rates (RRTRV >= 2.0 kV/μs), and utilizes binary SF6/CF4 (50/50) mixed gas to prevent liquefaction at -60°C Siberian arctic temperatures (ГОСТ 15150 УХЛ1).
- **Feichi FPC-REC vs. Tavrida Electric REC15/REC25 & Lucy Electric Trident**: Bi-stable magnetic actuator mechanics (100,000 maintenance-free operations from -50°C to +55°C), solid-dielectric HCEP resin poles (100% SF6-free), high-speed transient zero-sequence ($3I_0/3U_0$ 10kHz) ground fault detection, and sub-500ms decentralized peer-to-peer FLISR self-healing ring automation.
- **Feichi KYN28A vs. Siemens NXAIR / ABB UniSafe**: Equal 4-compartment LSC2B-PM metal segregation, IAC AFLR 31.5kA 1s arc containment, with flexible support for Chinese (VS1/VBD), European (ABB VD4/Schneider HVX), and Russian (Tavrida ISM/TEL) vacuum circuit breaker withdrawable cassettes, reducing project lead time by 40-50%.
- **Feichi 2КТПН / БМЗ vs. Russian Samara Electroshield**: 100% compliance with ГОСТ 14695 / ГОСТ 15150 УХЛ1 arctic climate (-60°C), factory-installed PTC heating and automated Опросный лист generation, with heavy-duty Cor-Ten steel chassis (09Г2С).
- **Feichi Eco C-GIS vs. Ormazabal cpg.1 / Siemens Blue GIS**: Synthetic dry air insulation (80% N2 + 20% O2, GWP=0), hermetically laser-welded AISI 304 stainless steel tanks (IP67), fully compliant with EU F-Gas Regulation 2024/573.
